text:
Marco Chen: FYI — console p95 looks lower than p50 for /v1/generate in EU region. Seen on multiple time windows. Anyone else? :thinking_face:
Priya Nair: Huh, can you paste the raw query you used? different dashboards use different rollups.
Marco Chen: pasted query:
```sql
SELECT host, percentile_approx(latency_ms, 50) as p50,
       percentile_approx(latency_ms, 95) as p95,
       percentile_approx(latency_ms, 99) as p99
FROM metrics.http
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND region = 'eu'
GROUP BY host
```
Also using histogram rollups for 1m buckets.
Luis Ortega: @Marco could be mixing `route` and `route_alias` — we recently added aliasing for model routing. If some traffic is labeled `/generate` vs `/v1/generate` the aggregator may merge buckets awkwardly. :eyes: 
Alyssa Park: Also check sampling keys — rollout-gate sampling uses `service->route` key while the dashboard uses `route_id`; that mismatch will create percentile artifacts when sampling is uneven.
Marco Chen: Good call. I see some samples with `route_alias=/generate` in the raw logs. That could explain negative counts when tdigest merges.
ingest-bot: ingest pipeline detected 12 mismatched route labels in last 1h for service=runtime-eu.
Priya Nair: Can we run a quick diff aggregate? I can run a one-off to compare tdigest vs raw histograms.
Luis Ortega: If it's aliasing, short-term fix is to normalize route labels in the metric transform (patch coming). Longer term we should update the console to roll up on canonical_route_id.
Marco Chen: Filing issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4210 — assigning to @Luis, label: telemetry, severity: medium. Will add example traces.
Alyssa Park: For the UI, let's add a tooltip warning when pX calculations use mixed sampling keys — UX team to propose copy. cc @devex
Priya Nair: Quick command I ran showed this pattern:
```
# show counts per route label
select count(*) from metrics.http where route like '%generate%' group by route_label;
```
returns 10234 /v1/generate, 430 /generate (sampled heavily)
Marco Chen: Thanks — going to normalize labels and rerun. Keeping thread updated. :thumbsup:
Luis Ortega: I'll push transform in 15m, will drop a deploy note.
Alyssa Park: (reaction: :rocket:)
